items.content:
Put cold brew concentrate in a pot of chili on a dare from myself. It works —
not coffee-flavoured, just deeper, like the pot has been going longer than
it has.

**Jun 8** — did it again with a spoon of cocoa too. Better. Writing this
down before I forget the ratio again like last time.

summary: Cold brew concentrate deepens the pot; cocoa added second pass
title: coffee in the chili
